newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges rates quoted mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges rates quoted mostly lower.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted mostly lower on Thursday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange. Six barges trded versus none on Wednesday.
- Four barges, two each week of Dec 22 and 29, Illinois, traded at 170 percent of tariff, down 40 percentage points from previous offer.
- Two barges, week of December 29, Illinois, traded at 170 percent, no comparisons.
- Two barges, this week, Illinois, offered 25 points lower at 185 percent, bid at 170 percent.
- Eight barges, two each week of January, lower Ohio, offered at 125 percent, down 2-1/2 points from previous offer, no bid.
- Ten barges, 30-day open, mid Mississippi, bid at an unchanged 160 percent, offered at 170 percent.
- Ten barges, 30-day open, upper Mississippi offered at an unchanged 210 percent, no bid.
